summary: Protected moves, deletes, case-only renames, potential policy weakening and non-equivalent trusted-base changes require a base pre-authorization consumed and deleted in the same change PR, verified with tree-entry tuples, a verified merge-base and NUL-separated raw diffs.
rationale: The existing IsProtectedGuardPath check blocks every delete or rename required by Plan 06, and a same-PR authorization would be self-authorization. Tree-entry tuples capture mode and type that blob IDs miss, --no-renames avoids heuristic matching, and gitlinks in protected scope fail. Merge-base soundness depends on ruleset strict mode, which P1.3 asserts. Within deferred item O1 the protocol makes protected changes explicit and traceable but cannot stop two-step changes. Plan 06 sections 12 and 17 D10.
